internal.title: High Latency Incident in Ad Service Resolved
internal.body:
At 11:35 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high latency in the ad service, with p95 latency reaching 1.8 seconds, exceeding the 1-second threshold. Concurrently, CPU utilization was observed to be very high at 0.98. The diagnosis confirmed that the high CPU utilization was the primary contributor to the latency issue. 

At 11:55 UTC, the mitigation action to disable the high CPU utilization flag was proposed, approved, and executed. Following this, latency metrics returned to normal levels (p95 latency reduced to 0.12 seconds), confirming recovery. 

No evidence of error injection was found, and error rates remained very low throughout the incident. The incident was resolved by addressing resource exhaustion causing latency.

Timeline:
- 11:35:21 UTC: Alert received for high latency
- 11:55:08 UTC: Diagnosis completed
- 11:55:13 UTC: Mitigation action executed
- Post-mitigation: Latency normalized

Action Items:
- Monitor CPU utilization closely to prevent recurrence
- Review flag management procedures to ensure timely response to resource exhaustion indicators
